back: Rectangle with rounded ends: START and STOP.
Rectangle: a calculation or assignment, e.g. `Total ← Total + Price`.
Parallelogram: INPUT or OUTPUT of data.
Diamond: a Yes/No (True/False) question with exactly two labelled exits.
Rectangle with an extra vertical line inside each side: calls a procedure or function with its own flowchart.
An arrow showing control passing from one shape to the next.
A flow line back to an earlier box. Test before the body: like WHILE. Test after the body: like REPEAT … UNTIL.
A decision whose Yes and No paths lead to different boxes and then rejoin: IF … THEN … ELSE … ENDIF.
Exactly six: flow line, process, subroutine, input/output, decision, terminator.
